title: Strength of Griffith's glass fibres against their diameter
description: Bar chart of the breaking strength of glass fibres of decreasing diameter, from a rod about 1 mm across (172 MPa) to a fibre 4.2 micrometres across (3,434 MPa). Source: A. A. Griffith, The Phenomena of Rupture and Flow in Solids, Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society A 221 (1921), Table V, converted from thousandths of an inch and pounds per square inch.
heading: BREAKING STRENGTH · MPa · BY FIBRE DIAMETER
